::: {.product-interpretation}
The latest 90-day precipitation share from days above the local 1991-2020 wet-day 95th-percentile amount is ranked against shares from 1991-2020 windows ending within two calendar days of this date. High ranks mean unusually strong dependence on very wet days, while low ranks mean less dependence; cells with less than 0.10 inch in total are blank.
:::
